history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1845 in Prussia and came to Chicago about 1866. He works as a sailor, and the household lives in the city's outer streets. The family's church is St. Michael's.
